about:
Sandtown Furniture Co. operates from Baltimore, Maryland, where it salvages wood from the city and transforms it into custom furniture. The company is led by partner and head designer James Battaglia, who oversees design and construction of each piece. No founding year or ownership structure is publicly disclosed.

The shop produces board room tables, conference and communal tables, restaurant and cafe tables, architectural millwork, and credenzas and storage units. Every item is designed and built in-house using reclaimed lumber sourced locally. The operation includes custom millwork capabilities and a dedicated event space called The Butterfly Room. Facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not published.

Sandtown serves commercial, corporate, and hospitality clients. Its portfolio includes projects such as the SANDTOWN HQ2 conference tables and custom millwork for office and restaurant environments. Customers range from architects and interior designers to businesses seeking one-of-a-kind furnishings.

The company's stated distinction is its closed-loop approach: salvaging urban wood from Baltimore and giving it a second life as finished furniture. This narrative of local reclamation and handcrafted construction is central to its identity.
